text: An independent audit found that the Northbridge payment system processed 99.9% of transactions within two seconds in February 2025.
A preliminary report found that the Northbridge payment system processed 97.0% of transactions within two seconds in January 2025.
An independent audit found that the Northbridge payment system processed only 82.0% of transactions within two seconds in February 2025.
The operator reported that a recent upgrade improved the response time of the Northbridge payment system.
